senses.gloss: m. (יבל, cmp. יְבוּל) the gate for carrying grain into the house, wagon-gate, gate-way. Pl. אִבּוּלִים, אִיבּ׳.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 11:10">Tosef. B. Mets. XI, 10</cite> <he>אין חולקין את אי׳ וכ׳</he> ed. Zuck. (ed. <he>הָאִבּ׳</he>) you dare not divide gate-ways between heirs unless there is the required space for each.
